Data sheet SBOS848B (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ina381.pdf, read 2026-10-02T21:10:27Z): common-mode input -0.2 to 26 V (covers 0.8 to 8.70 V, 12 V back-fed while off, 20 V through a failed converter; differential absolute maximum +/-26 V, so a braking servo's negative VSENSE drives the output to GND without damage and without a trip); supply 2.7 to 5.5 V (3.201 to 3.399 V passes); A1 gain 20 V/V, gain error 1 % max, offset 150 uV max at VCM 0 V and 500 uV max at VCM 12 V, comparator offset 5 mV max, hysteresis 50 mV; open-drain active-low ALERT (6 V absolute maximum) that pulls the TPSI3052 EN low; latch mode with RESET high, cleared when RESET is pulled low for at least 100 ns, so RESET goes to the port's enable and the trip holds the switch off while the enable is high; response: comparator alone 0.4 us typ / 1 us max, total small-signal alert 2 us typ / 5 us max, slew-limited alert 3 us typ / 10 us max (reported, V129 states no limit).
